title_en: Evda Went Out Through the Bazaar
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: 'Голај бива' is rendered 'it is easy' and 'џанам аџамија' as 'my dear rascal' (aџамија = novice or rogue), both my reading. 'Ми заличи' is rendered 'you suit'.

lines.en: Evda went out through the bazaar,

lines.cyr: низ чаршија Евда низ град Струга,
lines.lat: niz čaršija Evda niz grad Struga,
lines.en: through the bazaar, Evda, through the town of Struga,
to look for a tailor,

lines.cyr: да ѝ сошие ајде срмен елек,
lines.lat: da ì sošie ajde srmen elek,
lines.en: to have him sew her, come on, a silver-embroidered vest,
to have him sew her a silver-embroidered vest,
a silver-embroidered vest, Evda, for Easter.
Good evening, Mile, young tailor,
do you have a lot of sewing?
Tell me, my dear, what you want,

lines.cyr: и да имам тебе не те враќам,
lines.lat: i da imam tebe ne te vraḱam,
lines.en: and even if I had, I would not turn you away,
thank God, the Lord brought you to me,
Evda, you suit my little shop.

lines.cyr: Јас ќе шијам Миле срмен елек
lines.lat: Jas ḱe šijam Mile srmen elek
lines.en: I will sew, Mile, a silver-embroidered vest,
Mile, make up the bill,
how much money will you ask of me

lines.cyr: да ѝ кажам Миле на мајка ми?
lines.lat: da ì kažam Mile na majka mi?
lines.en: so I can tell my mother, Mile?
How much money will you ask of me

lines.cyr: да ѝ кажам Миле на мајка ми?
lines.lat: da ì kažam Mile na majka mi?
lines.en: so I can tell my mother, Mile?
For the bill, Evda, it is easy,
we will agree easily, Evda,
for the cutting, caresses,
for the sewing, Evda, kisses.
For the cutting, caresses,
for the sewing, Evda, kisses.
Close the window, Evda,
so I can light the little lamp,
so that it can be seen for the measuring,

lines.cyr: мера Евде пиле да ти земам.
lines.lat: mera Evde pile da ti zemam.
lines.en: I will take your measure, Evda, my dear.
So that it can be seen for the measuring,

lines.cyr: мера Евде пиле да ти земам.
lines.lat: mera Evde pile da ti zemam.
lines.en: I will take your measure, Evda, my dear.
Hey, you Mile, my dear rascal,

lines.cyr: земај мера море ти од око,
lines.lat: zemaj mera more ti od oko,
lines.en: take the measure, hey, by eye,
perhaps it will be nicer

lines.cyr: и за мене Миле и за тебе.
lines.lat: i za mene Mile i za tebe.
lines.en: for me, Mile, and for you.
Perhaps it will be nicer

lines.cyr: и за мене Миле и за тебе.
lines.lat: i za mene Mile i za tebe.
lines.en: for me, Mile, and for you.
